alt: The back of the Google Pixel 11 Pro being held in a hand, with the HiLight LED array glowing in vivid blue-green hues along the camera bar — the notification lights visible only because the phone is being shown from behind.
story: Google's Pixel 11 Pro (launched August 12, 2026, starting at $1,099) features 'HiLight' — an array of RGB LEDs on the back of the phone that glow to notify you of calls and Gemini AI activity; the fundamental problem, immediately noted by reviewers, is that the lights face away from you and are almost invisible during normal face-up use.
why_funny: A premium smartphone's headline new feature is a notification light placed on the side of the screen you're never looking at, and at launch it only tells you two things: a favourite contact is calling, or the AI is thinking.
